raw_reasoning:
Disabling direct messaging for all users under 16 is a policy/feature restriction that affects minors’ access to communication and their privacy/rights. However, the scenario doesn’t specify how existing users are informed or how “all users under 16” are identified, which limits certainty about whether some user/guardian notification/opt-out is expected.
